description: Cheapest round-trip business class fare between two cities, with dates, stops, cheapest departure month, cheapest nonstop and one-way fares, nonstop flights seen (airline, flight, airports), a lie-flat assessment and a booking link that opens a search on the quoted fare's dates (or the traveller's dates, if given).

adults.description: Adults for the booking link search.

depart_date.description: Outbound date (YYYY-MM-DD, today to 330 days ahead). Optional: the booking link then opens the search on the traveller's dates instead of the quoted fare's.

from.description: City name (e.g. "Milan", "New York") or 3-letter IATA city/airport code (e.g. "MIL", "JFK").

return_date.description: Return date; omit with depart_date for one way (YYYY-MM-DD, today to 330 days ahead). Optional: the booking link then opens the search on the traveller's dates instead of the quoted fare's.

to.description: City name (e.g. "Milan", "New York") or 3-letter IATA city/airport code (e.g. "MIL", "JFK").
